hero.headline: I-95 reopens in Martin County after fatal Honda-box truck crash, then closes again
hero.teaser: Northbound I-95 in Martin County reopened Monday after a deadly crash that killed a Honda driver, but the Florida Highway Patrol later closed all northbound lanes again for the ong
hero.body:
Northbound I-95 in Martin County reopened Monday after a deadly crash that killed a Honda driver, but the Florida Highway Patrol later closed all northbound lanes again for the ongoing investigation with traffic diverted to Indiantown Road.

 The driver of a 2020 Honda Civic died early Monday after the car crashed into the back of a 2027 Hino box truck and burst into flames on northbound I-95 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. The stretch of highway was closed for several hours after the crash before reopening.

 Troopers said the box truck was traveling north in the outside lane while the Honda traveled north in the inside lane and approached the truck. The front of the Honda collided with the rear of the box truck, and the Honda became fully engulfed in flames.

 The Honda driver was pronounced dead at the scene at 4:05 a.m. The driver has not been identified pending next-of-kin notification. The 37-year-old Miami man driving the box truck was not injured.
